vehicle_and_trajectory_description: Silver pickup with a dark open bed. It is already near the lower-left edge of the upper carriageway at clip start and continues toward the lower-left. The synchronized position, vehicle shape, lane, and immediate exit align across both cameras.

Dark blue-gray compact SUV/crossover with dark windows. It travels toward the lower-left in the middle lane of the upper carriageway and exits early. The apparent gray-versus-blue difference is consistent with lighting and camera color response.
White four-door sedan with a dark roof-glass or sunroof area. It remains in a median-side lane on the upper carriageway and moves continuously toward the lower-left without an evident lane change.
Dark-blue compact SUV/crossover moving toward the lower-left in the upper carriageway's middle lane. It enters the tighter highway2 view very late but is already visible in the wider highway3 view.

White sedan already at the extreme upper boundary when the clips begin. Only a small portion is visible in highway2, while highway3 retains it longer as it continues toward the upper-right. This is a partial-boundary match.

Red pickup with a dark open bed containing indistinct equipment or cargo. It remains ahead of the distinctive red flatbed truck and travels toward the upper-right in the same relative lane position in both views.

White compact sedan traveling toward the upper-right in the lane nearest the median. It maintains a steady, lane-centered trajectory and remains in the same relative position ahead of the nearby convoy.

White tractor cab pulling a long open flatbed loaded with large red covered industrial modules. It moves steadily toward the upper-right in a central lane. The unusual cargo, long geometry, and surrounding vehicles make this identity distinctive.

Silver or light-blue compact sedan positioned immediately right of the red flatbed truck. It travels upper-right roughly parallel to the truck and preserves the same lane and relative ordering across both camera views.
Black four-door sedan with a long, low roofline. It travels immediately left of the red flatbed truck toward the upper-right and maintains that distinctive side-by-side relationship in both views.
White midsize sedan with a dark sunroof or roof-glass section. It follows the outer exit-side lane toward the upper-right, remaining separated from the central convoy.

Dark-blue crossover/SUV with a boxy rear and dark windows. It travels toward the upper-right in a middle lane and remains paired spatially with a neighboring black SUV throughout the overlapping portion of the views.
Black compact SUV/crossover with a squared rear profile. It travels toward the upper-right in the lane closer to the median than the blue SUV and maintains the same relative ordering across cameras.

Brown tractor hauling a long silver or light-blue enclosed trailer. It enters from the lower edge, travels toward the upper-right in a central through lane, and remains visible at the five-second cutoff in both views.
White crew-cab pickup with a black open bed. It travels immediately left of the silver tractor trailer toward the upper-right, retaining the same side-by-side relationship across both cameras.

Dark-blue compact sedan with a conventional trunk. It travels immediately right of the silver tractor trailer toward the upper-right. Its position relative to the trailer is consistent, although the original highway3 trajectory list omitted it.
Light silver sedan with a slight blue cast and a dark sunroof or roof-glass panel. It enters late in the outer exit-side lane and continues steadily toward the upper-right through the cutoff.

White commercial flatbed carrying red or orange utility machinery. It enters very late from the lower edge and travels toward the upper-right in a middle-left lane. Only a short portion is visible in highway3, but the specialized load supports the match.
